title: Offer farm debt mediation before enforcing a farm mortgage
what: Take enforcement action under a farm mortgage only if the Act does not apply or an exemption certificate is in force (which follows mediation or the farmer's refusal of it).

sources.title: Farm Business Debt Mediation Act 2017 (Qld)
sources.quote: A mortgagee must not take enforcement action under a farm mortgage unless— (a) this Act does not apply in relation to the farmer or the farm mortgage; or (b) an exemption certificate is in force for the farm mortgage
